mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, which typically precedes positive equity market performance as companies benefit from stronger sales and investment over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST growth exceeds 1.0% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate indicates a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities as the economy faces overheating risks and higher discount rates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, a decline in UNRATE (monthly) is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it indicates persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing and supply chain activity, which correlates with higher corporate earnings and positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust demand and supply chain strength, which typically precedes positive equity market returns as economic growth accelerates over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and INDPRO both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 growth < 0.5% QoQ), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth < 0.5% QoQ, a decline in INDPRO is followed by positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
